diff --git a/django/utils/decorators.py b/django/utils/decorators.py
index 5c9a5d01c7..08cd1fa63d 100644
--- a/django/utils/decorators.py
+++ b/django/utils/decorators.py
@@ -17,6 +17,12 @@ def _update_method_wrapper(_wrapper, decorator):
     def dummy(*args, **kwargs):
         pass
     update_wrapper(_wrapper, dummy)
+    # If the decorator is a partial object, copy its __name__ attribute if it
+    # has one, otherwise use the __name__ of the underlying function.
+    if hasattr(decorator, '__name__'):
+        _wrapper.__name__ = decorator.__name__
+    elif hasattr(decorator, 'func') and hasattr(decorator.func, '__name__'):
+        _wrapper.__name__ = decorator.func.__name__
 
 
 def _multi_decorate(decorators, method):
